description: 8-K Item 2.02 press-release exhibits for an issuer, newest filed first. List items omit text (a document page). Titles may be null. One page via limit/cursor; optional from/to on filed. Free with no sign-in: AAPL, MSFT, JPM, KO, XOM, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, TSLA, LLY. Costs 3 credits. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess). A figure can change or disappear when a later filing arrives; figures are not versioned. Read `adjustments` for extractor decisions beyond copying one filed figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.
